Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony, 7 Oct) - THE ANIMATED TITLE SCREEN. The maypole view at twice the resolution, cut into layers: this row is the empty sky (it fills the screen). Every layer below is the same 1376 x 768 picture size and covers the screen the same way, so they line up. Sources and the scripts that cut them: art_source/pixellab/title_animated/ (work/build_layers.py, work/export_game_art.py); layered file art_source/aseprite/title_screen_animated.aseprite. The still screen it replaced: art_source/legacy/menu_round_an/MainMenu_maypole_still.csv.
The clouds, sliding slowly across the sky and wrapping round seamlessly. speed = pixels a second (bigger = faster wind; minus = the other way).
The village, the pitch and the maypole - everything that does not move. The ribbons are cut out of it (next two rows).

The maypole ribbons top right, tied at the top. amount = how far the loose ends swing (pixels), speed = waves a second, reach = how far down the ribbons hang, wave = how stretched the ripple is (bigger = calmer).

Motion Settings: from=bottom; amount=9; speed=0.45; reach=268; wave=200; phase=1.3; curve=1
Notes: The ribbons bottom left, tied at the bottom edge of the screen.
The Bavarian notice board the four buttons hang on (PixelLab). Its light panel is x 772-1183, y 689-1001 on the screen - the buttons in MenuConfig.csv sit inside it.
The hanging sign (PixelLab) with ropes long enough to leave the top of the screen. It swings round its top-middle: amount = degrees each way, speed = swings a second.
The name, written on the sign above and swinging with it (Motion follow). X / Y = its centre when the sign hangs straight, Height = the font size.

Motion Settings: sync=music; land=5; delay=3; fly=2; stay=5; leave=2; from=-160,240; to=2100,60; flap=10; arc=55
Notes: The Alpendohle with the Bavarian scarf (PixelLab). A strip of 3 poses: wings up, wings down, sitting. It flies in from the left, lands on the board's roof peak (X/Y = where it sits), sits 5 seconds and flies off to the right. ROUND AN (Anthony): sync=music ties it to the menu song, not a timer - it lands 5 seconds into the song (land=5) EVERY time the song loops, at the same beat. Change land to move it in the song. With the sound off it falls back to delay and flies once. It is the last row so it flies in front of the hanging sign.
